entities.summary: Zachary Kapono Wilson is an American professional football quarterback for the New Orleans Saints of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the BYU Cougars and was selected second overall by the New York Jets in the 2021 NFL draft. Wilson served as the Jets' starter during his first three seasons, but inconsistent play led to him being traded to the Denver Broncos in 2024. He joined the Miami Dolphins the following season. In 2026, Wilson signed with the New Orleans Saints.
